We conduct all experiments on a single NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU. For implicit target extraction, we employ GPT ${ 4 0 } ^ { 2 }$ . For stance prediction, we leverage multiple LLMs, including GPT-4o, DeepSeek- $. \mathrm { V } 3 ^ { 3 }$ and Qwen- $\mathbf { \cdot M a x ^ { 4 } }$ to independently infer stance labels. We adopt the encoder of the BART5 model pretrained on the MNLI dataset (Williams et al., 2018) as the Encoder. The learning rates of the Encoder and fully-connected layers are set to 2e-5 and 1e-3. AdamW (Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017) is utilized as the optimizer with a weight decay of 1e-4. The batch-size is 64, the maximum sequence length is 2OO and hidden dimension of 1024. We compare our model with several state-of-theart baselines into two groups: Table 3:Performance comparison of models on stance detection across zero-shot, few-shot and allsettigs. denotes results are taken from (Liu et al.,2O21), “ are taken from (Zhang et al.,2023),† indicates results from our reproduction,b are taken from the original papers and \* improves the best baseline at $p < 0 . 0 5$ with paired t-test. Results are highlighted with blue (↑) for improvements, purple $( )$ for stable and red (↓) for degradations relative to corresponding baselines.Best viewed in color.

(1） Models without External Information:BiCond (Augenstein et al., 2016) and CrossNet (Xu et al.,2O18) predict the class label based on the conditional encoding of the BiLSTM model. BERTjoint (Allaway and McKeown, 202O)and TGA-Net (Allaway and McKeown, 202O) encode the texts and targets using the BERT model, followed by classification with two fully-connected layers.PTHCL (Liang et al., 2O22a) and JointCL (Liang et al., 2O22b) adopt a contrastive learning strategy to mine the relationships and differences within stance features. (2)Models with External Information: SEKT (Zhang et al., 202O), CKE-Net (Liu et al., 2021) and BS-RGCN (Luo et al., 2022) apply the GCN to incorporate external knowledge into the stance detection process. CR-MTR (Zhang et al., 2023) and TTS (Li et al.,2023) both devise custom-made augmentation strategies from diverse dimensions. LKI-BART (Zhang et al., 2O24) integrates contextual knowledge generated by LLM.
